learning_outcomes.text: Students possess broad knowledge of mathematical functions and analysis.
Students can apply standard mathematical analysis procedures. They can describe and solve subject-specific problems using mathematical functions (modeling and problem-solving competence).
Students can apply mathematical functions and evaluate analysis in informatics, considering specific technicalities.
Students can analyze technical problems and transfer them into models using mathematical functions. They can explain these models and discuss them with colleagues.

assessment_rules: The assessment is a written examination. The duration and scope of the examination are as per the currently valid study regulations.
